service.en: Cancel the work permit of an employee with a labour court case
service.ar: إلغاء تصريح عمل موظف لديه قضية عمالية
service.ur: لیبر کورٹ کیس والے ملازم کا ورک پرمٹ منسوخ کرنا
service.ml: ലേബർ കോടതി കേസുള്ള ജീവനക്കാരന്റെ വർക്ക് പെർമിറ്റ് റദ്ദാക്കൽ

about: Cancel a work permit so an employee whose complaint went to the labour court can move on.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employee is registered in the Ministry's system and has an active work permit
A labour complaint has been referred to the Labour Court
No absence-from-work complaint against the employee
documents: Court ruling, if a verdict has been issued
Certificate of the active case showing the complaint status
